idea-plugin.name: Enum-Ordinal Persistence Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Warning on a JPA @Enumerated field with no explicit EnumType.STRING, on a real @Entity class -- JPA's own default is ORDINAL, and reordering or inserting a value in the middle of the enum after data has already been persisted silently corrupts existing records (the stored ordinal no longer corresponds to the same constant).

Confirms the field genuinely reaches persistent storage (the containing class is a real JPA @Entity), not just an annotation checked in isolation. A well-documented fragility (Baeldung and official JPA persistence guides); no Marketplace plugin found that flags it, despite several enum-tooling plugins existing.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only standard JPA @Enumerated on an @Entity class -- doesn't cover custom serialization (Jackson @JsonValue, protobuf enum) or non-JPA persistence frameworks.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
